unknown_item: That item is not in your item library.
item_inactive: :item has been retired and cannot be added to a new document.
items_inactive_on_submit: These items were retired while this was in draft: :items. Remove them before submitting.
only_draft_editable: Only a draft can be edited (this one is :status).
pr_not_convertible: A purchase order can only be raised from an approved requisition (this one is :status).
pr_line_over_ordered: Only :pending of :item is still outstanding on the requisition.
unknown_pr_line: That requisition line does not exist.
unknown_po_line: That purchase order line does not exist.
po_not_revisable: Only an approved order can be revised (this one is :status).
po_not_receivable: Goods can only be received against an approved order (this one is :status).
po_line_below_received: :item has already been partly received; the order cannot be cut below that.
revision_needs_reason: Give a reason for the revision.
vendor_cannot_supply: That vendor is not an active supplier.
store_not_in_factory: That store does not belong to the chosen factory.
bin_required_in_store: Choose a bin in the receiving store for :item.
over_receipt: Only :pending of :item is outstanding on the order. Revise the order or allow over-receipt in settings.
search_items: Search items by code or name…
no_items_in_department: No active items in this department.
open_duplicates: Other open requisitions ask for some of these items
open_duplicates_hint: A warning, not a block — check before you approve.
revise_hint: The order as it stands is saved to the revision history first. A revision that costs more than was approved goes back through approval; a line already partly received cannot be cut below what came in.
close_order_hint: Marks the outstanding balance as not coming.
complete_hint: Posts every line to stock. Cannot be undone.
no_outstanding_lines: Nothing is outstanding on this order.
booking_hint: Yardage held with the mill before there is a purchase order. Confirming it stakes a claim on the incoming stock, so the same metres are not planned for twice.
booking_item_not_in_bom: :item is not on style :style’s bill of materials.
over_booking_hint: Confirmed anyway — a booking follows the buyer’s forecast, which moves. Check it is deliberate.
material_requirement_hint: Worked out live from the bill of materials. Stock held for somebody else does not count as available, so the number is what still has to be bought rather than what is lying around.
requirement_pr_notes: Raised from the material requirement for cutting programme :number.
requirement_already_raised: Requisition :number was already raised for this programme.
requirement_fully_covered: Nothing is short — stock, bookings and open orders cover this programme.
no_bom_for_requirement: This style has no bill of materials, so nothing can be worked out.
landed_cost_hint: Freight, duty and clearing arrive weeks after the goods do. Spreading them over the consignment is what turns the purchase rate into what the stock actually cost.
preview_ready: Distribution worked out — check it before posting.
preview_empty: Nothing on these receipts can carry the charges yet.
post_warning: Posting moves the weighted average and re-prices fabric rolls, some of which may already be cut or issued. It cannot be undone — a mistake is corrected with a second voucher carrying the opposite charges.
rate_locked_hint: Landed cost has been posted against this receipt, so its rates are part of a valuation already reported.
landed_cost_needs_charges: A landed cost voucher needs at least one charge.
landed_cost_needs_receipts: Name the goods receipts these charges brought in.
landed_cost_nothing_to_apply: Nothing on these receipts can carry the charges.
landed_cost_receipt_not_posted: :number is :status, so it has no valuation to lift yet.
unknown_receipt: That goods receipt is not available to your company.
return_hint: Approval first, then the gate pass, then the stock comes down, then the supplier is debited. Nothing leaves the shelf until it is approved.
dispatch_hint: The gate pass, the stock movement and the debit note happen together — at the gate they are one event.
no_returns: Nothing has been returned to a supplier.
return_search_placeholder: Search by return or debit note number…
return_receipt_not_posted: :number is :status, so nothing of it is on the shelf to take back.
return_needs_vendor: A direct receipt with no supplier cannot be returned to one.
return_not_dispatchable: A :status return cannot be sent out.
return_exceeds_received: Only :available of :item is left to return.
roll_not_returnable: Roll :roll cannot be returned while it is :status — raise a claim instead.
unknown_receipt_line: That line is not on this goods receipt.
claim_hint: When the cloth has already been cut there is nothing to send back, but the loss is just as real — so what is claimed is money. No stock moves.
claim_not_open: A :status claim cannot take a settlement.
settlement_exceeds_claim: Only :outstanding of this claim is still outstanding.
advance_hint: A mill will not start weaving on a promise. Until the bills arrive this money is owed back in goods — the number that matters is what is still unaccounted for.
no_advances: No advances paid to a supplier.
adjustment_exceeds_advance: Only :outstanding of this advance is left.
adjustment_already_reversed: That adjustment has already been reversed.
advance_already_used: Part of this advance has been used, so it cannot be cancelled.
advance_order_vendor_mismatch: That order belongs to a different supplier.
advance_receipt_vendor_mismatch: That receipt is from a different supplier.
unknown_order: That purchase order is not available to your company.
import_documents_hint: The supplier's proforma invoice is what the bank opens a letter of credit against, and the shipment sails against both. A revised invoice is a new version, never an edit — the bank opened against the old one.
pi_revised: Version :version raised; the earlier one is now superseded.
pi_not_revisable: A :status proforma invoice cannot be revised.
unknown_proforma_invoice: That proforma invoice does not belong to this order.
lc_variance_hint: The difference between what the bank has committed and what the order is worth. A gap either way has to be amended before shipment.
lc_pi_not_live: That proforma invoice is :status — an LC cannot be opened against a document the supplier has replaced.
lc_not_amendable: A :status letter of credit cannot be amended.
lc_amendment_needs_reason: An amendment costs a bank charge and changes what the supplier can draw — say why.
lc_not_shippable: A :status letter of credit cannot carry a shipment.
unknown_letter_of_credit: That letter of credit does not belong to this order.
eta_hint: The first ETA is kept beside the current one. The gap between what was promised and what happened is the supplier's delivery record.
document_status_hint: Goods that have landed but whose papers are still at the bank cannot be cleared, so the two are tracked apart.
shipments_empty: Nothing on the water for this order yet.
shipment_search_placeholder: Search by shipment, B/L or container number…
no_proforma_invoices: No proforma invoice on this order yet.
no_letters_of_credit: No letter of credit on this order yet.
landed_cost_no_receipts: No completed receipt at this factory to charge.
basis_hint: By value where the charge follows what the goods are worth (duty, insurance); by quantity where it follows bulk (freight).
return_stock_moved: Sent out and taken off the shelf; debit note :debit_note.
contract_hint: A price fixed with a supplier for a period, so an order raised in September does not depend on somebody remembering what was agreed in March. A line that names its own rate keeps it — the contract only fills in what was left blank.
company_wide_hint: A price negotiated with a mill is normally a group price. Leave this on unless the agreement really is for one factory.
min_quantity_hint: The quantity this price starts at. Leave at zero for the base price, and add another line for a price break.
no_contracts: No rate contract has been agreed yet.
contract_search_placeholder: Search by contract number or supplier…
contract_needs_lines: A rate contract needs at least one agreed price.
contract_not_editable: A :status contract cannot be edited — orders have already been priced from it. Cancel it and agree a new one.
contract_rate_must_be_positive: An agreed rate has to be more than zero.
contract_period_backwards: The contract cannot end before it starts.
contract_collides: :item is already priced by contract :number over these dates. Two live agreements leave no way to say which is the price.
scorecard_hint: Scored on what the system already recorded — deliveries against promised dates, goods sent back, prices against what other suppliers charged, and claims raised. A measure with nothing behind it is left out rather than scored zero, so the card says which ones counted.
on_time_hint: Receipts against an order that promised a date. Orders with no promised date are left out — there is nothing to be late against.
quality_hint: By value, not by count: a rejected roll and a rejected button are not the same failure.
price_hint: This supplier against what everyone charged for the same items. 1.00 is the market rate; below it is cheaper. Blank when nobody else sold them.
no_scorecards: No supplier has been scored yet.
scorecard_empty: Nothing was received from this supplier in the period, so there is nothing to score.
